# The b. Life - theblife.com

## About
The b. Life is a digital platform and philosophy for intentional living in the modern world. Founded by David Crowell, it combines wellness principles with AI-informed perspectives to help people live more mindfully.

## Core Philosophy
The b. Life is built on seven principles:
1. Acceptance, Not Settling — Embracing what is without giving up on growth
2. Comfort as Achievement — Recognizing rest and ease as valid accomplishments
3. Quality Over Status — Choosing depth and meaning over appearances
4. Slow Down Intentionally — Making deliberate space in an accelerated world
5. Balance Over Burnout — Sustaining energy rather than depleting it
6. Community Not Competition — Growing together rather than against each other
7. Gratitude and Small Joys — Finding richness in everyday moments

## Content

### Book
"The b. Life" by David Crowell — a guide to intentional living through the seven core principles. Available on Amazon.

### Courses (Free)

#### AI for Humans
A human-centered guide to understanding and working with AI. 12 modules, 109 articles covering:
- Foundation Stories — How AI actually learns and works, explained through human analogies
- Working with AI — Practical collaboration with AI tools
- AI in Daily Life — Real-world applications from morning routines to decision-making
- Creativity & AI — How AI changes creative work
- Learning & Growth — Using AI as a learning companion
- Work & Productivity — AI in professional contexts
- Relationships & Communication — AI's role in human connection
- Mental Health & Wellbeing — AI and emotional wellness
- Ethics & Critical Thinking — Navigating AI responsibly
- Future & Philosophy — Where AI and humanity are heading
- Technical Concepts Made Human — Complex ideas in plain language

#### Living with AI
Intentional living in an AI-forward world. 8 modules, 71 articles covering:
- Acceptance, Not Settling
- Comfort as Achievement
- Quality Over Status
- Slow Down Intentionally
- Balance Over Burnout
- Community Not Competition
- Gratitude and Small Joys

### Community
Discussion spaces for members exploring intentional living, with feeds for general discussion and introductions.

### News
Personalized news feed covering AI, technology, wellness, and intentional living, curated through individual reader perspectives.

### Events
Local events for wellness, creativity, and community connection.

### Newsletter
Weekly insights on intentional living and AI-informed perspectives delivered by email.
